title: Determining Effective Drug Concentrations for Selection in Drosophila melanogaster
author: Matinyan, Gonzalez, et al.

steps.title: Set incubation environment
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 °C incubator with a 12 h light‑dark cycle and ambient humidity (experiments can be run between 18 °C–25 °C; lower temperatures lengthen the assay).

steps.title: Expand fly stocks for titration
steps.instruction: Expand each required fly stock so you have enough individuals for a full eleven‑point titration curve (vehicle control + ten drug concentrations) with four replicate vials per condition, each vial containing three females and three males (total 264 flies: 132 ♀, 132 ♂). Adjust numbers if using a smaller curve; use at least two flies of each sex per vial.

steps.title: Order control and marker strains
steps.instruction: Order the EGFP control strain and the appropriate drug‑marker strains (G418R, PuroR, BlastR, HygroR, GCVS, 5FCS) from the Bloomington Drosophila Stock Center; the EGFP strain serves as a negative control and the marker strains as positive controls for the titration.

steps.title: Collect and separate flies by sex
steps.instruction: Gather the required number of flies (no older than 3 weeks) for each strain and separate them by sex.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize flies of each strain using a blow‑gun CO₂ and dump them onto a fly pad with CO₂ flowing.
Under a dissecting microscope, use a brush to separate males from females (females need not be virgins).
Transfer the separated flies to fresh vials containing regular food, limiting to ≈60 animals per vial to avoid crowding.
While flies recover from CO₂, tip each vial on its side to keep flies from falling into the food.
After recovery, place the vials upright in a 25 °C incubator for at least 1 h (ideally 12 h) before the next step.

steps.title: Anesthetize and load flies into drug vials
steps.instruction: For each strain, anesthetize the separated flies again and add three males and three females to each prepared drug‑titration vial.

substeps.instruction: Place the flies on a fly pad with CO₂ running, handling one vial at a time per gender per strain to minimize CO₂ exposure.
Sweep the flies about halfway into the sideways‑oriented vial using a brush.
Plug the vial and keep it sideways while the flies recover from anesthesia.
Repeat the above for every vial representing each drug concentration for the given strain.
Once all flies have fully recovered, stand the vials upright in an appropriately sized tray and return them to the incubator.

steps.title: Incubate and monitor development
steps.instruction: Incubate the vials at 25 °C (or 18‑25 °C) for the duration of the assay; note that exposure to selection/counter‑selection agents typically delays larval development by about one week, which can be partially offset by higher temperature.

description: In a recent report, we developed a drug-based, selection and counterselection platform for multiplexed genetic manipulation in Drosophila melanogaster (Matinyan et al., 2021). We designed a compact expression cassette to test four different drug resistance and two drug sensitivity markers. We successfully selected resistant transgenic animals using the drugs G418 sulfate, puromycin, blasticidin S, and hygromycin B. We also demonstrated effective, drug-based counterselection against sensitized animals using either ganciclovir or 5-fluorocytosine. We then applied the selection/counterselection platform to make double transgenic animals in a single step, generated selectable and counterselectable balancer chromosomes, and made fluorescently tagged selectable P[acman] BAC transgenics (Matinyan et al., 2021). To facilitate expanding the platform to new applications, using it in different genetic backgrounds, or developing new markers that are resistant or sensitive to novel drugs, we provide a detailed protocol to perform drug titration curves to identify the optimal concentration for selection or counterselection.1.Expand the fly stocks you will be testing.Note: A typical titration curve featuring vehicle control and ten drug concentration testing points consists of four replicate vials per drug condition each containing three female and three male flies, totaling 264 flies (132 female and 132 male).
